coordinate_system.convert_position: [x, y, z] in Blender becomes [x, z, -y] in glTF
coordinate_system.assembly_delta_rule: Convert the difference exploded_positions minus ready_positions, then add to each imported glTF node rest position.

workspace_usage: Hide lounge chair/table/ribbon/lower-tree groups and attach a workspace export at model origin.
notes: Quality GLBs contain independent named geometry. Runtime GLBs preserve logical identities with empty anchors for batched members.
Studio ground, camera, HDR and physical lights live in Blender. Eight architectural ceiling-emission meshes are included in the quality main GLB.
Architecture uses single, double-sided panes and low-opacity alpha blending.

runtime_look.note: Art-direction starting values. Calibrate exposure, shadow softness and HDR intensity in the chosen renderer.

prototype_limitations: Editable reconstruction for implementation. The approved artwork is the finish target.
Runtime batch anchors retain identity and pose metadata. Use the quality GLB to change individual batched mesh materials or transforms.
Application integration, collision/navigation, measured mobile frame time and visitor retention are outside this model.
